api_key_needed: Add a Groq API key in Settings to use this tool.
api_key_needed_here: Transcription needs a Groq API key. Paste one here to start.
api_key_note: Transcription runs on Groq's servers. A free key from console.groq.com is enough for personal use, and it is kept on this computer only.
clear_finished_confirm: Finished jobs will be removed from this list. The files they produced are not deleted.
compress_audio_note: Audio only — the result is saved as M4A.
compress_target_hint: The result lands just under the size you asked for.
compress_target_too_low: That size is very small for this length — the picture will suffer, and the file may end up slightly over.
download_file_note: This link is a file — it will be downloaded as it is
error_api_key_rejected: Groq rejected the saved key. Check it in Settings.
error_network: Could not reach Groq. Check your connection.
error_rate_limited_day: Groq's daily limit for this model is used up. It frees up in {{reset}} — the other model has a budget of its own.
error_rate_limited_hour: Groq's hourly limit for this model is used up. More frees up in {{reset}} — the other model has a budget of its own.
error_rate_limited_request: Too many requests to Groq just now. Try again in {{reset}}.
library_next_to_input: Save edits next to the source file
library_next_to_input_hint: The media tools use the folder the opened file came from instead of the app folder.
library_note: Downloads and results are saved here. Choosing a different folder on a tool screen still applies to that job.
library_organize_hint: Separate folders for video, audio, compressed, trimmed, converted and transcripts.
library_reset_confirm: New files will be saved to the default folder again. Anything already in the current one stays where it is.
needs_audio: This file has no audio to extract.
needs_media: This file has no audio or video to work with.
needs_video: This tool needs a video file
no_internet: No internet connection. Please check your connection.
no_jobs_description: Anything you download or convert shows up here.
reveal_hint: Click a finished item to show it in its folder
tool_compress_about: Make a video or audio file smaller — squeeze the quality, drop the resolution, or land under a size limit.
tool_convert_about: Change the format of a video or audio file so it plays wherever you need it.
tool_download_about: Save video or audio from YouTube, Facebook, Instagram and hundreds of other sites.
tool_extractAudio_about: Lift the sound out of a video — exactly as it is, with no re-encoding, or as an MP3.
tool_transcribe_about: Turn the speech in an audio or video file into text you can read, search and edit.
tool_trim_about: Keep just the part of a video or audio file you want, and cut the rest away.
tools_bundled_note: These ship inside the app, so nothing needs installing.
transcribe_model_large_hint: Most accurate, and the only one that can translate
transcribe_no_audio: This file has no audio to transcribe.
transcribe_prompt_hint: Separate them with commas. Helps with unusual words.
transcribe_prompt_placeholder: Names, places or terms to get right
transcribe_translate_hint: Writes the transcript in English, whatever was spoken.
transcript_empty: No speech was found in this file.
transcript_truncated: This is the start of a long transcript. The whole thing is in the saved file.
transcript_unavailable: That transcript could not be opened.
transcript_working: Groq is transcribing this. It can sit still for a while on a long file.
trim_exact_hint: Slower, cuts exactly where you asked
trim_fast_hint: Instant, but may start a moment early
ytdlp_not_found: The download tool is not available. Try updating it in Settings.
ytdlp_update_note: Sites change how they serve video, and yt-dlp keeps up. Update it if a download stops working.
